newsitem.title: USA: Sun does Philadelphia reformer work early.
newsitem.headline: Sun does Philadelphia reformer work early.

text.p: Sun Co Inc, spurred on by an unplanned problem, began and completed planned maintenance on a 15,000 barrel per day (bpd) reforming unit at its Marcus Hook refinery near Philadelphia, a Sun spokesman said.
"It was back in operation as of yesterday," Sun spokesman Bud Davis said Thursday.
"The reformer was taken out of service on June 25 because they had a little problem, and they said: 'Instead of fixing that we'll just do the turnaround,'" Davis said.
On June 24, Sun said it was planning 20 days of maintenance on the unit beginning July 18.
A reformer raises the octane rating in a number of gasoline components making them suitable for blending into finished gasoline.
The Marcus Hook refinery can process about 175,000 bpd of crude oil.
